answer.says: Thank you. The cafeteria, you say? I shall look for something to settle this hollow feeling.
answer.thought: The guard’s gesture cuts through the abstract anxiety of my situation. I am still hungry, a fact that precedes any philosophical distinction between the particular and the universal. I will follow his thumb to the food.
